propositions: Impact-present ticket closes perform a full tracker-root directory walk once per unique historical reference candidate during commit resolution, resulting in O(unique_candidates × tracker_size) scaling.

Non-alias reference forms (8-hex short-ids, generic prefixes, four-digit fragments) call resolve_ticket_id branches that invoke os.listdir per candidate, while alias resolution was already bounded by a prior fix.
A synthetic repro with 80 non-alias candidates and a 5,351-ticket tracker recorded 82 tracker-root scans; the fix reduces this to 1 scan via a single prebuilt resolver index.

The fix introduces build_resolver_scan_index to perform one tracker pass and threads a sorted dir-name list to short-id and prefix branches, replacing per-candidate os.listdir with bisect-based lookups.
Descendant ticket credit, file-impact-vs-diff enforcement, and all reference form matching and ambiguity semantics are preserved unchanged.
A RED-first test verifies the bounded-scan regression and passes after the fix, with before/after evidence recorded.
